<thought>We need a template that forms a sulfonamide (S‑N bond). The valid functional group name is “sulfonamides”. We'll search the template catalog for templates that form this group and create an S‑N bond, limiting to a few results.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/CNc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "bonds_formed": ["S-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
